figurative_meaning_en: To block someone's means of livelihood
similar_in_english: To take the bread out of someone's mouth
To cut off someone's source of income
example_sentences_in_bangla: শত্রুরা তার ব্যবসার রুটি মেরে দিয়েছে।
এই সিদ্ধান্ত তার পরিবারের রুটি মারার মতো হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: His rivals have struck his business, blocking his livelihood.
This decision will be like hitting his family's bread, cutting off their income.
note: The idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on basic sustenance like roti in Bengali daily life.
